name: Funeral
overview: Scripture teaches that death is a solemn return of the body to the earth and the spirit to God, as seen in Ecclesiastes 12:7 and Psalms 146:4. The Lord provides comfort and strength to those who mourn, drawing near to the brokenhearted and upholding the fearful, as expressed in Psalms 34:18 and Isaiah 41:10. While honoring the dead, God commands against certain mourning practices such as cutting the flesh, emphasizing reverence for His holiness (Leviticus 19:28). Ultimately, the believer's hope rests in the Lord's shepherding care and sustaining presence through grief (Psalms 23:1).
